free_elimination.how: The option set {60, 24, 36, 40} is closed: 60 - 36 = 24 and 24/60 = 40. A reader of the options alone sees 60 and 36 as the start and end values and 24 as their difference, so 60% and 36% are the raw endpoints, not a percent change, and 40 is the only derived quantity. Needs one subtraction to spot, so borderline under the 'no arithmetic' wording; 24% (B) is the difference-as-percent lure and needs the base to kill.

items.note: (60-36)/60 = 40%. Option set encodes the passage values.
